name: honkit-plugin-mermaid-next
description: HonKit plugin for Mermaid 11/12 diagrams with CDN loading, dark mode, SPA re-rendering, lazy loading, and error handling.

theme.description: Mermaid theme: default, dark, forest, neutral, neo, neo-dark, base, or auto.

cdn.description: Load Mermaid from a CDN URL. Set to false and provide mermaidCdn for local hosting.

mermaidVersion.description: Major Mermaid version used in the default jsDelivr URL, for example 11 or 12.

mermaidCdn.description: Full or relative URL for the Mermaid ESM build.

lazy.description: Render diagrams only when they enter the viewport.

escapeHtml.description: Escape diagram source before inserting it into the page.

errorRenderer.description: Show a readable error block when a diagram cannot be rendered.

config.description: Additional Mermaid configuration merged into mermaid.initialize.
